description: "The Giraffe Hunters" by Captain Mayne Reid is an adventure novel written in the late 19th century. The book follows a group of young hunters—Hans, Groot Willem, Arend, and Hendrik—as they embark on an expedition to capture giraffes in Africa, driven by both the thrill of the hunt and the promise of a monetary reward.
